archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / HIGH-DENSITY B2B SAAS
app_type: dashboard / hybrid_fullstack B2B SaaS (construction quality & safety tracker)
emotional_tone: Tactical precision, structural authority, effortless high-density navigation, field-ready clarity
theme: Dark / Light hybrid theme optimized for high contrast outdoors and dense desktop operations. Slate Dark Sidebar (#0F172A) with Clean High-Contrast Workspace (#F8FAFC) or full Dark Mode toggle.

typography.heading_font: Barlow Condensed, sans-serif (or Outfit / Cabinet Grotesk)

hierarchy.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.card_title: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for default cards, shadow-md on slide-overs and modals, no fuzzy glassmorphism on dense data tables
visual_enhancers.cell_shading: Percentage-based alpha fill background for matrix cells (e.g., bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 for 100%, bg-amber-50 for partial, bg-rose-50 for high risk)
visual_enhancers.status_bar_charts: Segmented horizontal progress bars showing multi-colored breakdown of Visis (Green/Grey/Blue/Orange/Red)

layouts.sidebar: Persistent left sidebar (260px width) with company/project dropdown switcher, main navigation (Dashboard, Multi-Template Tracker, Location Tree, Visis, Companies, Setup), and interactive multi-tier location tree accordion.
layouts.top_bar: Sticky top bar on list/matrix views with search input, company/trade filters, status multiselect, location depth filter, date range, and primary CTA actions (New Visi, Export CSV, QR Export).
layouts.matrix_tracker: Spreadsheet-style Multi-Template Tracker matrix view. Fixed/frozen left column for Location hierarchy, top two-level header (Company -> Checklist Template), cells showing x/y completed count, percentage progress ring/pill, hover highlight across row and column.
layouts.slide_over: Full-height right slide-over sheet for Visi detail with tabbed sections: Checklist items with checkboxes, requirements & evidence photo upload, attachments strip, detailed timeline/activity feed, and metadata side-panel.
layouts.attachment_modal: Full-screen or large modal viewer with image canvas (zoom in/out, rotate 90 deg, pan), EXIF/GPS metadata display panel, embedded satellite/map thumbnail showing geotagged coordinates, and quick tags.

components_mapping.navigation: Custom LeftSidebar with Collapsible LocationTree and CompanySwitcher
components_mapping.filter_bar: TopFilterBar with Select, MultiSelect, SearchInput, DatePicker, FilterBadges
components_mapping.tracker: MultiTemplateTracker Matrix Table with sticky headers, progress indicators, cell detail tooltips
components_mapping.visi_sheet: Sheet component for Visi detail with ChecklistProgress, AttachmentStrip, ActivityFeed
components_mapping.attachment_modal: Dialog component for EXIF metadata viewer with canvas zoom/rotate controls and Map view
components_mapping.status_badge: VisiStatusBadge implementing strict 5-color QA status code
components_mapping.location_tabs: Tabs component (Overview, Visis, Milestones, Attachments, Documents, QR Export)

motion.matrix_cell_hover: Subtle scale-102 or background highlight transition 150ms
motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all interactive elements

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_target: AA compliance with high contrast text on all status badges (minimum 4.5:1 ratio)
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, menu links, status pills, and matrix cells MUST contain data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="visi-status-badge-closed", data-testid="matrix-cell-building-a-level-1", data-testid="company-switcher-trigger")

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure strict color coding for status badges: Green (#DCFCE7/#166534) for Closed/Complete, Grey (#F3F4F6/#374151) for Open, Blue (#DBEAFE/#1D4ED8) for In Review, Orange (#FFEDD5/#C2410C) for Dispute, Red (#FEE2E2/#B91C1C) for Can't Close/Overdue.
Build a persistent left navigation bar with collapsible location tree (Building -> Level -> Room -> Sub-room).
Construct the Multi-Template Tracker as a high-density matrix with fixed frozen location column, top company->template headers, and clear x/y progress indicator cells.
Include Visi Detail slide-over sheet with checklists, evidence photo attachments, activity feeds, and assignee/reviewer controls.
Include Attachment Modal with image zoom/rotate controls, simulated EXIF/GPS metadata display, and embedded map preview.
Maintain high density, clean B2B SaaS interface without unnecessary bloated spacing on data tables.
Add testid attributes (data-testid) to all key controls, buttons, tables, filters, and metrics.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_tone: Clean, dense, data-heavy B2B SaaS UI like Procore / Visibuild / Fieldwire.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_purity: Never use un-tinted pure black or generic soft gradients for data tables.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Smooth 150ms transitions on hover states, table rows, and status badges.
